name: mcp-doc-hooks
description: Claude Code framework: inject invariant/pitfall docs into agent context on first contact with each MCP server/tool/sub-tool, with configurable per-server modes, thresholds, whitelist/blacklist filtering, cross-process locking, and automatic state cleanup.

scripts.check:coupling: npm run check:deps && npm run check:duplication
scripts.check:all: npm test && npm run check:coupling && npm run test:mutation
